title: StaffRole (DRAFT)
description: An office held by a party for a period. Approving authority belongs to the office, not permanently to the person. DRAFT — not approved.

role.description: Only president is eligible to approve under dual_control today. forest_committee_chair submits. Both approving offices are held by exactly one person at a time so that 'the President' is unambiguous in an approval record.

revokedAt.description: Revocation is immediate and never waits on approval — removing authority from someone compromised must not require a committee.
